layers.core: domain-independent structural runtime, objects, math and rendering
layers.domains: reusable instantiable implementations organized by domain
layers.host: application instances, project state, WebEngine orchestration where used, wiring and host-specific workflows

allowedDependencies: WebEngine host integration -> S3D core/domains when spatial presentation is required
invariants: core never imports a domain module
domain terminology is allowed when implementation is reusable outside its originating application
host-provided data does not transfer canonical application authority into S3D
